quick_skim.title: ReCache: Efficient KV Cache Reuse and Compression for Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
quick_skim.abstract: Agentic language models repeatedly encode tool and skill schemas that recur across requests in different combinations and orders, preventing standard prefix caching from reusing their key--value (KV) states. We introduce \textbf{ReCache}, a framework for independently caching resource representations while reducing their inference-time computational and memory overhead. Resource-wise attention removes cross-resource interactions and assigns resource-local positions, producing composition-invariant KV blocks. ReCache then restricts resource visibility to contribution-selected layer--KV-head-group routes and retains only invocation-critical fields through structural and semantic pruning. We evaluate ReCache on a benchmark assembled from seven public tool- and skill-use datasets, including resource-disjoint tests. Resource-wise attention matches dense invocation performance (82.3\% versus 82.4\% Inv-F1) while providing a 3.655$\times$ time-to-first-token speedup. The complete framework reduces allocated KV-tensor memory by 92.43\% and accelerates attention by 1.423$\times$. These results show that separating reusable schema encoding from selective resource access substantially reduces agentic inference costs with limited effectiveness loss. The code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/ReCache.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: Efficient KV cache reuse and compression for tool-augmented LLM agents, directly addresses scalable attention for agents.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Proposes ReCache, a framework for caching and compressing KV states of tool resources in agentic LLMs, reducing inference-time memory and computation via resource-wise attention and pruning.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 工具增强型LLM智能体在请求间重复编码工具与技能模式，导致标准前缀缓存难以复用KV状态。本文提出ReCache框架，通过资源级注意力去除跨资源交互并分配局部位置，从而生成与组合顺序无关的KV块，再经贡献选择和剪枝压缩存储。在七个公开数据集上的基准测试中，ReCache减少了推理时的计算和内存开销，提高了智能体系统的可扩展性。该方法为智能体环境下的注意力加速提供了实用压缩方案。

quick_skim.title: A multi-agent molecular optimization framework leads to a rapid-recovery intravenous anesthetic candidate with an improved safety margin
quick_skim.abstract: Lead optimization, the systematic refinement of therapeutic compounds through iterative structural modification, faces a dual challenge in modern drug discovery: navigating astronomically vast molecular design spaces while balancing conflicting demands on potency, pharmacokinetics, and safety. We present MASCOT (Multi-Agent SearCh for molecular OpTimization), a role-specialized multi-agent framework for molecular optimization. Integrated with a chemically constrained graph-editing search, MASCOT coordinates three specialized agents: a trade-off agent that reprioritizes competing objectives, a strategy agent that adapts how molecular edits are proposed, and a reflection agent that distills lessons from previous decisions. Computational experiments showed that MASCOT achieved the best performance over competing methods on six benchmark settings. On the SARS-CoV-2 main protease task, its mean docking-score improvement was 3.6 times that of the strongest baseline. Applied to the clinically used anesthetic remimazolam (RM), MASCOT prioritized RM-1, which showed a shorter liver microsomal half-life, higher brain exposure, and a larger therapeutic index than RM. Subsequent derivative design yielded RM-7. Extensive animal studies established RM-7 as a rapid-recovery intravenous anesthetic candidate with greater potency, faster functional recovery, a wider safety margin, and preserved flumazenil reversibility. These results demonstrate that multi-agent coordination can link adaptive molecular search to medicinal chemistry and experimental pharmacology.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: MASCOT is a role-specialized multi-agent framework for molecular optimization, coordinating trade-off, strategy, and reflection agents within a chemically constrained graph-editing search to balance conflicting drug design objectives.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对药物先导优化中分子空间巨大且药效、药代与安全性需求冲突的问题，本文提出MASCOT，一个角色专业化的多智能体优化框架。该框架集成化学约束的图编辑搜索，并协调三个专职智能体：权衡智能体重排竞争目标，策略智能体调整分子编辑方式，反思智能体提炼经验。在静脉麻醉候选分子优化中，MASCOT获得了恢复快且安全窗更优的候选化合物，展示了多智能体协作在分子优化中的有效性。
